description: This file contains a CMake macro named 'map_iterator_next' that manages iteration over a map-like data structure within CMake scripting. It moves an iterator to the next element and returns whether the move was successful, updating relevant variables.

methods.name: map_iterator_next
methods.description: Advances the map iterator to the next element and sets a return value indicating success or failure. It updates variables for the current key and value, and indicates whether the iterator has reached the end.
